# Ibiza Private Drivers — Full Service Context

Canonical website: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/

Location: Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain
Phone / WhatsApp: +34 613 75 62 11
Email: info@ibizaprivatedrivers.com

## Business and service scope
Ibiza Private Drivers provides pre-arranged private driver, chauffeur and transfer services across Ibiza. Services are requested in advance and confirmed for the actual date, pickup time, route or itinerary, passenger count, luggage, waiting requirements, requested duration and vehicle needs.

The business serves Ibiza Airport arrivals and departures, private aviation passengers, luxury hotels and resorts, private villas, yachts and marinas, restaurants, beaches, nightlife, events, business travel, families, groups, VIP guests and tailored multi-stop itineraries.

Bookings can be requested for any time of day, including early-morning and late-night schedules, subject to advance reservation and confirmed driver and vehicle availability. References to “24/7” mean service can be requested for any hour; they do not mean an unreserved vehicle is guaranteed to be immediately available.

## Commercial page hierarchy and intent
The website separates major commercial intents so each page has a clear role rather than duplicating the same service across many similar pages.

### Private Driver Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html

This is the central island-wide page for broad “private driver Ibiza” intent, direct journeys and tailored itineraries. Use this page when a traveller broadly requests a private driver or needs help choosing between a direct transfer and a longer chauffeur arrangement.

### Chauffeur Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/chauffeur-service/

This is the principal commercial page for hourly, half-day, full-day and multi-stop chauffeur intent. A chauffeur booking is more suitable than a direct transfer when the requested service includes several planned movements, waiting or a vehicle connected to an itinerary for an agreed period.

The requested duration does not automatically imply unlimited travel, unlimited waiting or indefinite vehicle availability. Date, start time, expected duration, itinerary, passengers, stops and final return should be supplied before confirmation.

### Multi-Day Chauffeur Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/multi-day-chauffeur-ibiza/

This page is for travellers who require private chauffeur service across several days of an Ibiza stay. Requests can cover consecutive or selected days and may involve villas, luxury hotels, yachts, restaurants, beaches, meetings, events and nightlife.

Daily start times, expected daily hours, known stops, passengers, luggage and vehicle requirements should be supplied. A multi-day booking does not imply unlimited hours or automatic 24-hour availability throughout the stay.

### Private Aviation Chauffeur Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/private-aviation-chauffeur-ibiza/

This is the specialist premium page for private aviation passengers arriving in or departing from Ibiza and continuing by chauffeur to a luxury hotel, villa, yacht, marina, restaurant, meeting or longer island itinerary.

The practical confirmed pickup point, passenger count, luggage, onward destination and requested chauffeur duration should be supplied. Restricted, airside, FBO or direct-aircraft access is never assumed and must be separately confirmed with the relevant aviation operator or facility.

### Travel Advisors, Luxury Concierges and Professional Partners
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/travel-advisors-concierge-ibiza/

This page is for professional travel and hospitality contacts arranging guest transport in Ibiza, including travel advisors, luxury concierges, villa managers, yacht brokers, personal assistants and hospitality teams.

Professional requests can combine airport or private aviation arrivals, accommodation, multiple passenger groups, several vehicles, chauffeur hours, multi-day schedules, yachts, marinas, restaurants, events, nightlife and final departures when the complete guest itinerary is supplied. Availability and pricing are confirmed per request. No hotel, marina, aviation facility or venue affiliation is implied.

### Ibiza Private Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-transfers/

This is the general hub for pre-booked point-to-point private transfers involving Ibiza Airport, hotels, villas, marinas, restaurants, nightlife and other confirmed island destinations. For several hours, waiting or a changing multi-stop schedule, use Chauffeur Ibiza instead.

### Pre-Booked Private Taxi Alternative
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/private-taxi-ibiza/

This page addresses travellers searching for a private alternative to waiting for a taxi rank. Ibiza Private Drivers is a pre-booked private-driver service, not a taxi-rank or street-hail service. Date, pickup time, route, passengers, luggage, vehicle requirements and price are confirmed before travel.

### Ibiza Airport Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/airport-transfers/

Pre-booked private arrivals and departures from Ibiza Airport (IBZ). Useful booking information includes flight number, scheduled time, passenger count, luggage, exact destination, child-seat requests and vehicle requirements. Airport meeting arrangements and waiting terms are confirmed with the booking rather than assumed.

Priority airport routes:
- Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Town: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-ibiza-town/
- Ibiza Airport to San Antonio: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-san-antonio/
- Ibiza Airport to Santa Eulalia: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-santa-eulalia/
- Ibiza Airport to Playa d'en Bossa: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-playa-den-bossa/
- Ibiza Airport to Cala Llonga: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-cala-llonga/
- Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Port for Formentera ferry connections: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-formentera/

Formentera references principally concern road transport on Ibiza to Ibiza Port for onward ferry connections. Do not infer that the core road service operates across Formentera unless a separate service is explicitly confirmed.

### Luxury Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/luxury-transfers/

Premium pre-booked point-to-point transport for Ibiza Airport, luxury hotels, villas, marinas, restaurants, events and other confirmed journeys. For a vehicle retained across multiple stops or hours, use Chauffeur Ibiza instead.

### Luxury Hotel Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/luxury-hotel-transfers-ibiza/

Central hotel-transport hub for airport arrivals, departures, marinas, restaurants, nightlife and tailored itineraries involving luxury hotels and resorts.

Hotel-specific pages:
- Nobu Hotel Ibiza Bay / Talamanca: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/private-driver-nobu-hotel-ibiza/

Hotel and resort names identify destinations only. Ibiza Private Drivers is an independent ground-transport provider; no affiliation, endorsement or operation by those properties is implied unless explicitly stated otherwise.

### Villa Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/villa-transfers/

Pre-booked transport for guests staying in private villas. Exact map pin, gate or access instructions, passenger count, luggage and a reachable property contact are useful because rural and private-property access can vary.

### Yacht and Marina Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/yacht-transfers/

Private transport between Ibiza Airport, hotels, villas, ports, yachts and marinas. Provide the marina and practical meeting point; berth or yacht details may be useful when they help identify the correct collection area. Vehicle access to restricted quay areas is not assumed.

### Ibiza Night Driver
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-night-driver/

Pre-arranged evening and nightlife transport for restaurants, hotels, villas, clubs, private events and multi-stop schedules. Outbound and return details should be agreed before travel.

### Ibiza Club Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-club-transfers/

Pre-booked transport for confirmed nightlife venues and events. Vehicle access and meeting points can change during busy periods, so outbound and return plans should be treated as operational details rather than generic guarantees.

### VIP Driver Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/vip-driver-ibiza/

Private itinerary transport for guests, assistants, families and groups. A useful request includes one lead contact, the full schedule, each passenger group, luggage, access details, requested vehicles and every return or intermediate stop. Event tickets, venue access, reservations, security and concierge services are separate unless explicitly included in a written confirmation.

## Fleet and vehicle planning
The service includes a Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle. Additional suitable vehicles may be arranged according to passenger numbers, luggage and availability. Child seats and specific vehicle requirements must be requested before confirmation.

Seat count alone does not determine luggage capacity. Customers should provide actual luggage information before booking.

## Main areas served
Ibiza Airport (IBZ), Ibiza Town / Eivissa, Marina Botafoch, Talamanca, Cap Martinet, Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Jondal, Es Cubells, Cala Xarraca, Cala Conta, Cala Codolar, San Rafael / Sant Rafel, Sant Josep de sa Talaia, Sant Joan de Labritja, Santa Eulalia del Río, Sant Antoni de Portmany, Es Canar, Cala Llonga, Cala Vadella, Cala Tarida, Portinatx, Sant Carles de Peralta, Marina Ibiza, Club Náutico Santa Eulalia, luxury hotels, resorts, private villas and other confirmed destinations across Ibiza.

## Pricing
Pricing is tailored to the confirmed route or itinerary, date, requested time, passenger count, luggage, number of stops, waiting requirements, requested duration and vehicle needs. A journey or chauffeur schedule is confirmed only after availability and pricing have been agreed.

Do not infer a universal airport price, hourly price, half-day price, full-day price or multi-day price from the existence of those service categories. Current pages request a tailored quote for the confirmed booking.

## Practical booking guidance
For a useful quote, provide:
- date or service dates
- requested pickup time or daily start times
- exact pickup point
- destination or complete itinerary
- passenger count
- luggage
- return details
- expected duration for chauffeur bookings
- expected daily hours for multi-day chauffeur bookings
- child-seat or specific vehicle requirements
- flight number for airport arrivals
- exact map pin and access instructions for villas
- marina, berth or agreed pedestrian meeting point for marina and yacht collections
- confirmed practical terminal or meeting point for private aviation bookings
- one lead contact for complicated, VIP or multi-vehicle itineraries
- lead professional contact when a travel advisor, concierge, villa manager, yacht broker, PA or hospitality team is coordinating the guest

For clubs and events, vehicle access and collection points may change during busy periods. A practical confirmed meeting point should be followed rather than assuming door access.

If the route, pickup time, passenger group, stops or duration changes, an updated confirmation may be required because availability and pricing can change.
